source.title: World Rubik's Cube Championship 2009 on October 9-11, 2009 in Düsseldorf, Germany
source.content: The [World Rubik's Cube Championship 2009](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=WC2009) will take place on October 9-11, 2009 in Düsseldorf, Germany. Check out the [World Rubik's Cube Championship 2009 website](http://www.speedcubing.com/events/wc2009) for more information and registration.

translation.title: 2009 年世界魔方锦标赛将于 10 月 9–11 日在德国杜塞尔多夫举行
translation.content: [2009 年世界魔方锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=WC2009)将于 2009 年 10 月 9–11 日在德国杜塞尔多夫举行。更多信息及报名请见[赛事网站](http://www.speedcubing.com/events/wc2009)。
